classification: editorial continuity index; on-page facts and future writing proposals are explicitly separated
coherence_rules: All six novels contain 50 linear chapters. Chapter numbers and endings are retained.
The first-person adult Jasper practices disclosed ethical non-monogamy and prefers polyamory; each relationship remains distinct.
Ba Sing Se's Jasmine Dragon is not Jasmine Steps; Beach City venues are not physically located in the Lanternweald.
Closed Bells keeper remains unknown. Authorized upper inspection space is not a license to open the sealed historic lower flood route.
The separate temporary surface runoff channel is only safe within its posted tested limits.
Real wages, materials, safety, privacy and consent persist across novel boundaries.
